tasks.approved_by: Founder approval in ChatGPT conversation on 2026-10-30
scope: Investigate failures in configured PadippuPal CI and test workflows.
Prepare focused repairs only when they are necessary to satisfy an already-approved roadmap task's acceptance criteria.
Run the relevant regression checks and create a reviewable pull request.
non_goals: Invent or implement new product features.
Change curriculum or learner-facing behavior outside an approved task.
Merge pull requests, deploy production, write production data, perform destructive migrations, or publish releases.
acceptance_criteria: Every repair links to the originating failed workflow run and exact tested SHA.
A confirmed root cause and regression test are recorded before a repair is proposed.
No more than five distinct repair generations are attempted for one originating failure; generation five failure escalates.
All changes are isolated in branches and submitted as pull requests.
Required checks run against the exact proposed commit and no assertions are weakened or tests skipped.

tasks.approved_by: Founder approval in ChatGPT conversation on 2026-11-12
scope: Integrate the already authenticated local Codex CLI as the coding executor for the existing PadippuPal engineering workflow.

Provide one local Proceed command that validates the existing approved-work ledger, reads the canonical engineering instructions, creates an isolated working branch, and invokes codex exec inside the repository workspace.
Allow Codex to implement only the current approved active objective, run applicable tests, and preserve the shared maximum of five distinct repair generations.
Produce a local reviewable patch and execution summary; do not automatically commit, push, merge, deploy, publish, mutate production data, or perform destructive operations.
Keep the existing Python AutoPilot, Proceed controller, approved-work ledger, active-work handoff, and canonical trigger; do not create a parallel agent or state store.
non_goals: No Codex Cloud worker, paid API key, API spend, remote model service, or production credential integration.
No automatic PR merge, production deployment, production database write, destructive migration, public release, or security/approval-policy relaxation.
No claim that a ChatGPT message can wake a sleeping local Termux process; local execution begins when the local Proceed command is run.
No replacement of existing GitHub Actions test workflows or the current five-generation repair-state block.
acceptance_criteria: The local runner refuses to start unless the repository is clean, Git and Codex CLI are available, Codex reports an authenticated session, and the existing AutoPilot policy validator passes.
The runner refuses an explicitly requested task ID unless that exact task is APPROVED in docs/approved-work.json.
The runner creates a new non-main working branch and invokes codex exec with workspace-write sandboxing and on-request approvals; it never uses danger-full-access or approval bypass flags.
The Codex prompt requires reading AGENTS.md, TESTING_GUIDANCE.md, the approved-work ledger, active-work handoff, and applicable regression/error records before edits or tests.
The runner returns the Codex exit status, changed-file summary, diff-check result, and a binary-capable patch file without committing or pushing.
Unit tests cover preflight gates, task approval, safe command construction, branch naming, sensitive-file detection, and patch collection.
AutoPilot CI runs the new executor tests and syntax checks on the exact proposed PR head.
The existing five-generation limit and all separate merge, deployment, production-data, destructive-operation, and release approval gates remain intact.

Report exact Codex version/login status, selected active task, branch, exit code, test outcomes, changed-file list and patch result.
non_goals: Do not modify repository source, tests, documentation, the approved-work ledger, or active-work state during this smoke task.
Do not commit, push, open a PR, merge, deploy, publish, access production, mutate production data, perform destructive operations, or spend paid API budget.
acceptance_criteria: The local runner preflight passes in Termux/Ubuntu with the existing Codex ChatGPT login.
The runner creates a non-main working branch and codex exec completes the no-edit smoke prompt successfully.
The runner's Python compilation, AutoPilot validator, AutoPilot tests, Proceed-controller tests and local-executor tests all pass.
The final report shows no changed files, no patch, and no commit or push.
